title: I Gave A Free AI A Million Words Of My Business
description:
NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra is free on OpenRouter and holds a 1,000,000 token context window, roughly 750,000 words or 1,500 pages in a single conversation. 550 billion total parameters with 55 billion active per response, a hybrid Transformer-Mamba mixture-of-experts design, plus tool calling. That means you stop chunking your documents and start asking questions that need all of your material at once.

Get the free setup guide and the three prompts here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16HufHr35Vr4B4XE2dSoMn9cC0lCOY1fthXMvfemUH5k/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #NVIDIA #FreeAI
